messages:
alice: Starting deploy for release r2026.03.20 — canary -> prod. Pushing tag redwood/v1.14.2 now (10:00 PT). Release notes: https://confluence.internal/release/r2026.03.20. Who's owning the unwind path if we need to abort? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy started: service=user-unwind, tag=redwood/v1.14.2, strategy=canary(5%). Canary started at 10:03 PT. Monitoring: infra/metrics, tracing, error-budget. See runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/unwind-service-runbook

ben: If canary error rate >5% sustained for 5m or latency p95 up >200ms, criteria to abort. Plan: pin traffic back to redwood/v1.14.1 and scale canary to 0. Also keep the previous pods hot. @carol can you confirm the pin API? :thinking:

carol: Runbook is the source of truth — section "Emergency unwind" has the exact commands. Quick snippet here for pin + scale: ```# pin version
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/services/user-unwind/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"version":"redwood/v1.14.1","reason":"canary-abort"}'

# scale down canary
kubectl --context=prod scale deployment user-unwind-canary --replicas=0 -n prod
```

dan: Confirming DB migrations were run as shadow migrations in canary — no destructive schema changes. Fallback is flipping feature flag off if anything upstream breaks: ```curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/user-unwind-feature/disable" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"```

emily: I'm on-call for the 10:00-12:00 window and watching errors/traces. I'll escalate to @pagerduty if error budget >3% in 10m. Also will run the quick smoke test list after canary: login, create session, embed flow. :thumbsup:

ben: Also add routing policy pin as a safety: set routing.policy.fallback=true in config-store so LB will prefer fallback pool if control plane pin fails. Small JSON we use in the runbook — I'll paste if needed.

alice: Thanks all — I'll proceed. I'll post canary metrics here every 2m. Tagging the runbook link in case we need it quickly: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/unwind-service-runbook#emergency-unwind :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Update at 10:05 PT: canary deployed to 5% (instances=4). Observed p50/p95 latency change +8ms/+12ms, error rate 0.2%. No alerts. Continuing monitor.

carol: If we do full rollback, follow these condensed steps from runbook: 1) pin to previous version (API call), 2) disable new feature flag, 3) scale canary to 0, 4) verify via smoke tests and traces, 5) open incident ticket for post-mortem. I'll be available if needed.

ben: Setting alert thresholds now. Will DM for the LB JSON.

alice: Great — keeping this thread as the canonical unwind checklist for this deploy. I'll update with metrics and final status.
